name: Sovereign Logos Scripture MCP
description: Verbatim public-domain scripture for agents: the Septuagint (Brenton and LXX2012), KJV with Apocrypha, Geneva, WEB and 1 Enoch. Keyless and read-only; every passage returns a citation URL, translation, licence and publisher. All tools only read and keep Guard's usual handling. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Every tool is read-only: none writes to an account, sends messages, uploads local files or needs a key. Requests are rate-limited per IP.
For a fixed reference without an MCP session, the same passages are served by the keyless REST endpoint https://sovereignlogos.com/api/v1/scripture/passage?ref=John+1:1&translation=kjv.
